book.name: EPESO
book.title: ME EPESO ꞌIDI LETA PAULO ꞌIꞌETOLADINA

content: Yaubada ꞌina obobomega niꞌatu ꞌiꞌawa natunemi, ꞌenega tauna ꞌina bubuna wada etotowanei,
be wate wada eoboobobomemi nadigega Keliso ꞌioboboma ꞌeseda, ga tauna ꞌitagwalena ga ꞌitaliyaena Yaubada ꞌenaya manuda, ga ꞌimwawasa.
ꞌOmi Yaubada ꞌana toemisao, ꞌenega ꞌilobwenena be loelata be sogala be gwegwe ꞌana yala wapilisinedi, ta geyaꞌabo manudi toꞌase ꞌebweu waonaonae.
Wate geyaꞌabo ꞌawasewa nai ꞌawatoꞌumali nai onabesobeso, manuna ona nidi nigeya ꞌadi lobwene solamiya, ta esi ꞌimi onega Yaubada wada tupui.

Ta onaꞌaiꞌaila, totoꞌumalidi geyaꞌabo wate silugulugu Keliso be Yaubada ꞌidi ꞌebeloina ꞌenaya, taudi nadigega toloelatao nai tosogalao nai gwegwe ꞌana toyala diidigao, manuna gwegwe ꞌana yala ꞌana mwalatoi ꞌaene ꞌida emisa tasaꞌui gwegwe ꞌenaya, ta nigeya Yaubada ꞌenaya.
Maedana manuna
Bubuna getedi manudi Yaubada toleꞌoa loina ꞌigamwasowaledi, ꞌenega geyaꞌabo ꞌebweu yaita ꞌina ona besobesoega ꞌikabokaboemi,
be wate geyaꞌabo toleꞌoa loina nidi maꞌemiyao waegosigosiyana,
manuna ꞌomi guguyoi lowa ꞌenega niꞌatu waabalama Yaubada ꞌina maedana ꞌenaya, ꞌenega ma imi bubuna maemaedanina waguiguinuwa,
be bubuna nidi boboꞌadi ta palupaludi ta ꞌaiꞌailidi siapweapwesa maedana ꞌenega.
Be wate watootoo be toꞌase ꞌInapwana nuwanuwana wada mwalatonidi be waguinuwedi,
ta guguyoi ꞌana guinuwa besobesodi ꞌediyega wadena, ta esi wada eꞌitaedi ꞌaene toꞌumalidi.
Onaꞌaiꞌaila ꞌebe omayamaya, ꞌabo ꞌidi guinuwa kwaikwaiyidi manudi taonaona,
ta ꞌabo ꞌebweu guinuwa toꞌumalina ꞌiloapwese maedana solanaya, sawesawenaya be taꞌitai, be ꞌabo niꞌatu taꞌitaꞌitai, tauna saꞌi maemaedanina.
Gete manuna Buki Tabu ꞌena ꞌigwae, “ꞌOyo toꞌenoꞌeno, mwawasega ꞌutoolo be Keliso ꞌina maedana ꞌenega ꞌuda maedana.”
ꞌIlobwenemi be ꞌimi bubuna waꞌitaꞌiꞌita ꞌaiꞌailidi be geyaꞌabo waguiguinuwa besobeso, ta esi wada sinasinapu ꞌaiꞌaila,
be geyaꞌabo tuta wamudamudali, manuna gete tuga tuta toꞌumali wawasae.
ꞌEnega geyaꞌabo waeuwauwa, ta esi nuwami ꞌida sabwalena, toꞌase Yaubada ꞌina nuwanuwa manumi nadigega.
Geyaꞌabo bwasi waiwaina ꞌenega wanumanuma kabaleya, nate yage ꞌebe esilae, ta esi Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌida loemaemi be
wada waliwali magosemiyao, wali tapwalolo, be Same walinao, be wate edale walinao ꞌediyega, ma imi gwausowala ꞌatemiyega wawawali ꞌInapwana ꞌenaya,
be tuta maiboꞌana wada lokagutoki yage maiboꞌadi manudi, ꞌida ꞌInapwana Yesu Keliso ꞌana esanega, Tamada Yaubada ꞌenaya.
Taudi aiai nidi ꞌadi loina
ꞌImi ꞌamayaba Keliso ꞌenaya nadigega wate taumimo waeꞌamaꞌamayabemi, be loina waematamatanedi.
ꞌOmi iine aiai nimi mwanemiyao ꞌidi ona waematamatanedi, nadigega ꞌimi ematamatana Keliso ꞌena,
manuna waine ꞌana toanugana nate mwanena, nadigega Keliso toekalesiyao ꞌada toanugana be ꞌada Toꞌetoseyana, ta ꞌaboꞌada ꞌatuwa oona welawelaꞌanao,
ga toekalesiyao ꞌaboꞌada Keliso ꞌina ona taematamatanedi, ꞌenega nadigega wate iine ꞌilobwenedi be mwanediyao ꞌidi ona yage maiboꞌadi manudi sida ematamatanedi.
Aiai nimi meꞌolotomi ꞌilobwenemi be mwanemiyao waobobomedi, nadigega Keliso ꞌina toekalesiyao ꞌiobobomeda, ga tauna ꞌitagwalena, ga manuda ꞌimwawasa,
ꞌada gieꞌesasa manuna, nate ꞌida toꞌumalina ꞌana ꞌebeꞌutu bwasina ꞌina ona ꞌenega,
be ꞌenega toekalesiyao ꞌaboꞌada ꞌietooloda ꞌaene ꞌina bodao maemaedanida, ta nigeya baila nai ꞌebweu toꞌase toꞌumalina ꞌedaya, ta esi maiboꞌana tuga boboꞌana, ta ꞌesasena.
ꞌEnega ꞌaboꞌada meꞌolotoda ꞌilobweneda be mwanedao taobobomedi, tauda bwalada ꞌatuwa. Manuna ꞌabo yaita mwanena ꞌiobobome, taunamo niꞌatu ꞌioboboma limena.
Manuna nigeya ꞌebweu wate tai taunamo oona ꞌena ꞌida etalauwala, ta esi ꞌiꞌitaꞌiꞌisi be ꞌana masula ꞌieꞌani oona ꞌana lema manuna, nadigega Keliso toekalesiyao ꞌaboꞌada ꞌiꞌitaꞌiꞌisida,
manuna ꞌaboꞌada tauna oona welawelaꞌanao.
“Gete manuna tai tamana be sinana ꞌipilisinedi be mamwanena sida miya eꞌebweu, ꞌatuwa oo ꞌebweuna namo.”
Ona gete ꞌatuwa onasemalimali kwaikwaiyina, ta ꞌana mwalatoi Keliso be toekalesiyao manuda.
ꞌEnega ꞌilobwenemi be ꞌebweuna ꞌebweuna mwanena ꞌida obobome tauna ꞌatuwa, be waine aiai nina ꞌilobwenena be mwanena ꞌida ꞌamayabe.
